pages.name: Claude Code: legal and compliance
relies: The Claude Code binary must not be modified.
customers may not remove, disable, or restrict any authentication method built into it
Each end user must authenticate with their own Anthropic API key, Claude subscription plan credentials, or 3P inference provider credential
You can accurately say, in plain text, that your product has Claude Code preinstalled or that it runs Claude Code.
developers may not collect, store, or intermediate Claude.ai credentials or session tokens
Nor does it prevent an end user from signing in to the unmodified Claude Code binary with their own Claude subscription

pages.name: Claude Agent SDK: overview
relies: Unless previously approved, Anthropic does not allow third party developers to offer claude.ai login or rate limits for their products
Your product should maintain its own branding and not appear to be Claude Code or any Anthropic product.

pages.name: Claude Code: data usage
relies: We give you the choice to allow your data to be used to improve future Claude models.
Anthropic does not train generative models using code or prompts sent to Claude Code under commercial terms
Users who allow data use for model improvement: 5-year retention period
Users who don't allow data use for model improvement: 30-day retention period
Metrics never include your code, prompts, or file paths.
Only the hostname is sent, not the full URL, path, or page contents.
